title: ConnectionTestResult
description: Result of the connections.test JSON-RPC method. The single declaration of this shape: the renderer's TypeScript type is generated from it and the Go transport is validated against it.

outcome.description: Typed probe outcome. host-key-unknown means the host is not in known_hosts at all (routine first contact); host-key-changed means the offered key differs from the stored one (the MITM signature). The renderer must never call a changed key 'unknown' or offer the routine accept button for it.

detail.description: Human-readable detail sentence for the outcome, suitable for display.

hostKey.description: Host-key evidence, present only for the two host-key outcomes. Carries the displayed target, the backend-issued known_hosts lookup identity, and the offered key so the renderer can show its fingerprint and echo knownHostsHost+key back to connections.trustHostKey. A host key is public material (ADR-0011 §3): it may cross the wire and be displayed.

host.description: Resolved address as probed (host, or host:port), the exact string known_hosts matching used. The trust call must use this same string or the appended line will not match the next probe.

knownHostsHost.description: Exact backend-issued storage identity used by known_hosts matching. It equals host for a direct route and is an opaque route-specific hostname for a target reached through jump hosts. The trust call must use this value, never derive it in the renderer.

changed.description: True only when this route already has a stored key that differs from the offered key. The renderer uses this backend classification; it must not infer security state from human-readable error text.

algorithm.description: Key algorithm of the offered key, e.g. ssh-ed25519, ecdsa-sha2-nistp256.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the offered key.

storedFingerprint.description: Fingerprint(s) recorded in known_hosts for this host. Present only when outcome is host-key-changed: the user cannot judge a changed key without both fingerprints.

key.description: Base64-encoded wire-format public key blob of the offered key. Echoed back verbatim by connections.trustHostKey.
